title: Conjugating -er verbs, nothing
summary: This is the key conjugation trick. For -er verbs, the je / il / elle forms sound like the verb with the -er dropped: manger → je mange, il mange, elle mange (written with a final e). Negatives can swap pas for rien (nothing): Il ne mange rien. Je ne regrette rien.
points: -er verbs: drop the -er sound. confirmer → je confirme, manger → il mange.
Written with a final -e so the last consonant is pronounced: mange, confirme.
essayer de + verb = to try to: J'essaie de manger.
ne … pas = not. ne … rien = nothing / not anything. rien goes where pas would.
Casual speech drops ne: Il mange pas. Il mange rien.
e + double consonant sounds like è: regrette, baguette, elle.
